notes.title: Addition of Steam Global Region and Mac User Information
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/d20b5135274b4652d041c0beba83a3981495ed29.png[/img]


Greetings from the Summoners War: Chronicles team!

Global regions will be available on Steam from Mar. 9th.
You can also enjoy Summoners War: Chronicles on Mac.

Please check below for more details.

---------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1][b]▌ Steam Global Region Addition[/b][/h1]

[b]▶ Schedule[/b]
- US East: Mar. 6th 1am (UTC-5)
- US West: Mar. 5th 10pm (UTC-8)
- EU: Mar. 6th 7am (UTC+1)
- Japan: Mar. 6th 3pm (UTC+9)
- SEA: Mar. 6th 1pm (UTC+7)
[b]
▶ Details[/b]
- EU, SEA, and Japan regions will be added to Summoners War: Chronicles.
- You can select the region if you've installed Chronicles for the first time.
- If you've already played Chronicles, tap the globe button at the bottom right of the title screen to change the region.
- EU and Japan have 2 servers each, and SEA has 3 servers.
[h3][b][Server Names by Region][/b][/h3]
- EU: Liebli, Tilasha
- Japan: Nephthys, Tiana
- SEA: Ariel, Verdehile, Lupinus

[b]※ Precautions[/b]
- Character info is not synced between regions and servers. Changing the region will start the game with a new character from Lv. 1.
- You cannot transfer your Summoner data to a different region or server if you've already selected and played on a region and server."

---------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1][b]▌ Steam Mac Guide[/b][/h1]

[b]▶ Schedule[/b]
- US East: Mar. 6th 1am (UTC-5)
- US West: Mar. 5th 10pm (UTC-8)
- EU: Mar. 6th 7am (UTC+1)
- Japan: Mar. 6th 3pm (UTC+9)
- SEA: Mar. 6th 1pm (UTC+7)

[b]▶ Details[/b]
- Mac users can now play Summoners War: Chronicles on Steam.
- Open Steam on Mac and search Summoners War: Chronicles to install and play the game.

[b]▶ Mac Minimum Requirements[/b]
- CPU: Intel x64
- RAM: 8GB
- GPU: Metal Capable GPU supported by Apple
- OS: Mac OS X 10.11 equivalent or higher
- Storage: 10GB


[b]※ Precautions[/b]
- The game will not run on Macs with lower specifications than the minimum requirements.
- At least 10GB of free space (HDD) is required to install.

[b]▶ PC Version Account Sync[/b]
 -  Login Methods: Hive membership, Google, Apple, Facebook
 -  You can play as existing characters by logging in to the account on Android and iOS devices.
 -  The currently synced account can be checked via [Settings]→ [Account] →[Account Sync] in-game."

---------------------------------------------------------------------

We hope you enjoy your Chronicles adventure on global regions and Macs.

Thank you.

tags.feature: Global regions will be available on Steam from Mar. 9th.
You can also enjoy Summoners War: Chronicles on Mac.
- EU, SEA, and Japan regions will be added to Summoners War: Chronicles.
- Mac users can now play Summoners War: Chronicles on Steam.

notes.title: 2nd Half of 2022 Update Roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/020d442e62e01e35587d9c9a4893ae6303e784b5.png[/img]

Greetings from the <Summoners War: Chronicles> team!

The end of the year is just around the corner and we hope you had a fun and happy Thanksgiving with your friends and family.

We would like to introduce the Summoners War: Chronicle update roadmap for the second half of 2022.

The new raid Castle of White Shadows, and the new Monster Pioneer will be added on November 24th.
In December, two new raids, new Monsters, and contents full of amazing rewards will be added, so we hope you all look forward to them.

We are also announcing that the target number of people for the field co-op event How to Make Friends will be adjusted in the November 24th update.

Please check the image below for more details about the 
update roadmap, and have fun with Summoners War: Chronicles!

[h3][b][2nd Half of 2022 Update Road Map][/b][/h3]
※ The update schedule and content below are subject to change depending on certain circumstances.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/6ce564f41472aa324912b9cb35b5495cbd13203b.jpg[/img]

We will continue to inform you about major updates in the future through another update roadmap.

More information about the main content will be announced during the update.

Thank you.

Please update the game to the latest version from your game platform.

Please read below for more details about the update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/b96b2240cf0ce0e2100273d8fd07a055ed0896e6.png[/img]

* Limited-time packages or their individual components may reappear in the shop or in crafting recipes later on.

- Sale Period
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/af7a6ed45c1009df30cbb12dc1902d68f0d27f57.png[/img]
- Check out the brand new 3 Waikiki Outfit Packages.
- Available via [Package Shop] > [Outfit] at the top-right of the main menu.
[Kina]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/3c9272bce8b8f2b39903c35a36b5b3a6ddde1e05.png[/img]

[Orbia]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/5de435c8d9547b97122b2176d0b3dd512f2f258b.png[/img]

[Cleaf]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/b117e11e65294501bc7c1344103f76b76924e462.png[/img]

▶ New Release : Duck Boat Ride
- Sale Period
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/af7a6ed45c1009df30cbb12dc1902d68f0d27f57.png[/img]
- The Cute Duck Boat Package has been released.
- Available via [Package Shop] > [Special Price] at the top-right of the main menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/27148e922f8fa9fc78b19eb15ed9d2533901e393.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/aff4f87f258f567c5f9ac796d5811da0369cdf53.png[/img]

▶ Shell Collection Event
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/83f3b300db7294c4a1ff83519a29291ca51aca5d.png[/img]
- Event Period
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/af7a6ed45c1009df30cbb12dc1902d68f0d27f57.png[/img]
- Event Details: Use trowels and get various rewards from shells including a 5★ Desert Queen (Water)!
* Trowels can be obtained from the Collect Trowels Event.  
* Use the Reset button to reset the board.

▶ Collect Trowels
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/baf060631c36a980e973f80b812be519f59478f2.png[/img]
- Event Period
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/af7a6ed45c1009df30cbb12dc1902d68f0d27f57.png[/img]
- Event Details: Complete Collect Trowels missions to find Trowels required to find gifts from shells gathered by the Desert Queen!
* Collect Trowels missions can be completed repeatedly during the event period.
* Purchase the Summoner Pass to get 2x Path of Growth mission rewards.

[Monsters that can be obtained from the Shell Collection Event]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/8171c05d06696ff51d6333d290bf9e5bfa75d95d.png[/img]
- Basic Info: 5★ Desert Queen (Awakened Name: Bastet) | Water | Support
- Keywords: #ATK DOWN, #ATK UP, #Shield, #Mana UP, #Ultimate Gauge UP

- Skills and key Effects
[Curse of the Beautiful]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/e458e0c835f70a66089ad31b51159e9e133bc1a5.png[/img]

Attacks enemies within the area 3 times, and each hit has a certain chance to apply ATK DOWN.
 
[Oasis's Blessing]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/433c98c0a89ba56f02b686306157fe965d0481fe.png[/img]
Applies ATK UP and Shield to nearby allies
(Lv. 5 Awakening) Increases mana if the Summoner's HP is full

[Ultimate Oasis's Blessing] (Lv. 5 Awakening)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/9c6e49e526b479a1d2b2f1d79fa725e8dff5aaad.png[/img]
Applies ATK UP and Shield to nearby allies and increases the Summoner's ultimate gauge.

▶ Guard Welcome Ceremony
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/298d7d7c528c48bcb32cd9ac8d419b0fc968613b.png[/img]
- Event Period
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/af7a6ed45c1009df30cbb12dc1902d68f0d27f57.png[/img]
- Event Details: A check-in event to welcome and celebrate the new guards! 
  Get the Mystical Scroll, Light and Darkness Scroll, and Legendary Scroll!
* Check-in resets every day at 00:00 (PST), 03:00 (EST).
* If you logged in but did not collect the reward,
you can still claim it the next day and then claim today's rewards.

▶ Make Your Monster Stronger 1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/56dabe95fe52ba7d297d9fb6caceba0791c9a834.png[/img]
- Event Period
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/af7a6ed45c1009df30cbb12dc1902d68f0d27f57.png[/img]
- Event Details: Upgrade your Monsters to get various rewards including 5★ Rainbowmon, Legendary Scroll, and more!

▶ Lucky Bingo
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/5c2cd46174c5cfb2f6ed0c7c9082fbab6d35e665.png[/img]
- Event Period
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/6e87a132f1712719034e9c4bfadf339ebca40edb.png[/img]
- Event Details:  Complete the Bingo board with 4-leaf Clovers that can be obtained by clearing Road of Growth and get Breath of Life, 3-5★ Monster Piece Box, and more! Crystals are granted every time you complete a Bingo.
* Use the Reset button to reset the board.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/78d4259a8fcb19b0e5c30bfe94db45a8ef1da2af.png[/img]	

▶ EVENTS
- Certain '7 Days of Special Missions' event mission conditions have been changed.
  * Before: Clear certain dungeon levels
  * After: Clear certain dungeon levels or higher

▶ Repeat Requests
- The number of defeated creatures needed for Repeat Requests has been adjusted for each continent.
Continent	Adjustments
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/4b30c18eb4029129c195ed8d7253005cf10b6d94.png[/img]

▶ Expedition
- The Monster participation condition In the 1st stage of Expedition Dungeon has been removed.

▶ Piece Exchange Shop
- The price of 4/5★ Rainbowmons in the Piece Exchange Shop have been adjusted
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/caa05be4efdd0cf20504b47eefbc99582b9afb8b.png[/img]

▶ Battlefield
- The difficulty of the Queen Spider Dungeon during the quest has been lowered.
  * Poison dot damage has been removed from summoned spiders.
  * Arachne's damage has been reduced to 70%.
  * The poison damage and cooldown of the jump attack have been adjusted.

▶ Other Changes
- Additional loading tips have been added for better experience.
* Added tip : EXP Potions are used to level up monsters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/7e8242ce6e03e342255ec3123b5a6b14829efc2f.png[/img]

▶ UI/UX
- Fixed an issue where certain text on Equipment Disassembly or the Guild Request Screen appeared in a different language.
- Modified the descriptions of Story 7 and 8 of the [Joy of Creating Together] Area Exploration Quest in the Rukurangma region to match the story.
- Fixed the typo in the Rift guide image. 
- Changed the loading screen to match the actual type of Expedition being played. 

▶ Other Changes
- Fixed an issue where the game freezes on the title screen when playing on certain Pixel devices.

________________________________________

That’s everything we got for the 11/17 (Thu) Update Note.

Thank you.
